title: Rational internal-Hom and dualizing identifications
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$. Use the coefficient categories, derived tensor and internal Hom, and constructible exceptional functors of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Choose an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. The structure system is the already normalized exceptional coefficient system at $a_X:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. For a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a coherent integral dualizing datum $w$ of [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum], and a rational datum $A$ of [def-sf-rational-verdier-data], a Hom identification supplies permitted internal-Hom pairs, the tensor/internal-Hom adjunction with its integral evaluation normalized by the inverse completion comparison, a natural identification of the dual of $A$ with internal Hom into the rationalized $w.\omega$, and equality of the resulting evaluation with $A$ evaluation. The dualizing identification predicate for a structure system, a finite coefficient field and $w$ means that rationalized $w.\omega$ is isomorphic to that system exceptional image of the actual coefficient unit, namely the localized completed regular module in degree zero. None of these definitions asserts existence of these identifications.
